This application coming on for Order this day, the court passed the
following:
 Order

This is first application filed under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to applicants,
who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.447/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 506 and 34 of the IPC, registered at Police Station Padav District Gwalior (M.P.).
The applicants are apprehending their arrest in the aforesaid case.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants has drawn attention of this Court to the order dated 13/02/2023 passed Manish Kumar Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76550841/
1 in M.Cr.C. No. 61874/2022 by which co- accused persons who are also main accused persons Bhoor Singh Meena and Shivraj Meena were granted benefit of anticipatory bail by this Court, as the alleged defrauded amount of Rs. 6,72,000/- was returned to the complainant before this Court and complainant expressed satisfaction with regard to repayment of total amount which was allegedly defrauded by the co-accused persons.
Allegations against the applicants herein is that they were agents in the company.

sentences.text: No specific allegation with regard to direct involvement in allegedly causing loss to the complainant has been revealed in the investigation so far.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, as main accused persons have already been granted anticipatory bail after they returned allegedly defrauded amount to the complainant, it would not satisfy the ends of justice, if the applicant herein is arrested.
Under the circumstances, the application is allowed.

It is directed that if the applicants herein are arrested by the Arresting Officer, they shall be enlarged on bail upon their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.

This application coming on for Order this day, the court passed the
following:
 Order
This is first application filed under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to applicants,
who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.447/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 506 and 34 of the IPC, registered at Police Station Padav District Gwalior (M.P.).
The applicants are apprehending their arrest in the aforesaid case.
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants has drawn attention of this Court to the order dated 13/02/2023 passed Manish Kumar Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76550841/
1 in M.Cr.C. No. 61874/2022 by which co- accused persons who are also main accused persons Bhoor Singh Meena and Shivraj Meena were granted benefit of anticipatory bail by this Court, as the alleged defrauded amount of Rs. 6,72,000/- was returned to the complainant before this Court and complainant expressed satisfaction with regard to repayment of total amount which was allegedly defrauded by the co-accused persons.
Allegations against the applicants herein is that they were agents in the company.
